title: Zindan se rihaa
body:
Zindan se rihaa
(Haye hussaina) x6
<<MINI>>
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
(Allah ye kya hogaye sadaat) x3 Kuch karbobala hogaye sadaat
<<MINI>>
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ye kaysi rihaayi he ke dil khush nahi hota) x2
(Kya rehgayaa zindaan me ke har qaydi hai rota) x2
Ho apni sakina se judaa hote hai sadaat.
<<MINI>>
Allah, mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ay shamiyo ab chayn se araam se sona) x2
(Be chayn karenga na kisi bachi ka rona) x2
Jo shaks wo bukaa karti thi rowengi kabhi maa.
<<MINI>>
Allah, mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Zainab ne kaha qayd me hai mera khazana) x2
(Ay aurto jab shaam chale is taraf anaa) x2
Gurbat pe sakina ki piya ret jalaa na.
<<MINI>>
Allah mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Sajjad pe zewar jo asiri ke utare) x2
(Sukhe huwe sab zakhm har ik kho gaye sare) x2
Sar dekh ke baba ka tarap kar wo pukaare.
<<MINI>>
Allah mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Zainab ne ridaa pak kaha shukr khudaa hai) x2
(Abbas mere bhayi magar sadma baraa hai) x2
Sar nange hame saraa jahaa dekhta hai.
<<MINI>>
Allah mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Mazloom jo ik lafz abhi tashnagi boli) x2
(Is lafz rasan bazu ki sajjad ne kholi) x2
Kehne lagi kya jaaye watan khali hai joli.
<<MINI>>
Allah mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ye kafla jab karbobala lot ke aya) x2
(Dekha ke para doop me hai bhayi ka lahsa) x2
Zainab ne sare khaak balaa khud ko giraaya.
<<MINI>>
Allah mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kya shaan thi sadaat ki jab ghar se chale the) x2
(Mehmil thi amari thi mashkize bhare the) x2
Abbas-e-alamdar alam khole huwe the.
<<MINI>>
Allah mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Galiyo me madine ki ajab shor bapaa hai) x2
(Sughra se abhi aake kisi ne ye kaha hai) x2
Aa sughra tera baba watan lot raha hai.
<<MINI>>
Allah mere Allah
(Zindan se rihaa hogaye sadaat) x2
